errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the years on the x-axis are arranged in alphabetical order ('азбучен ред'), when they are arranged in chronological order.

errors.text_span: като всяка година е етикетирана със съответната стойност в зетабайти
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The labels on the x-axis are the years themselves (e.g., '2010', '2011'). The data values in zetabytes are labeled on top of each bar, not on the year labels.

The description fails to mention the most prominent visual feature of the chart: the clear, consistent, and steep upward trend in data volume over the entire period. This is the primary message of the visualization.
